narration:0:1510943001:0.text: The beasts summoned by the Hunting Goddess finally die. The clash of weapons across Windchoke Fen slowly fades.
narration:0:1510943001:0.source_cn: 狩猎神召唤出的野兽被你们悉数清理，风沼战场上的兵戎交接...

narration:1:1510943002:0.text: But the wind still carries the cries of the wounded and dying...
narration:1:1510943002:0.source_cn: 然而，凄厉的风又将此起彼伏的哭喊送进你们耳中……

narration:2:1510943003:0.text: And above all, one sound stays with you—Kordan's howl of grief, cradling Oboe's lifeless body in his arms.
narration:2:1510943003:0.source_cn: 最令你惊讶的是，戈丹痛彻心扉的哀嚎……和他怀中已没有生...
